title: Concept: Restore writes packages into a shared machine location
description: nuget.config declares a `globalPackagesFolder` outside the workspace, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads a `globalPackagesFolder` outside the workspace.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through nuget.config (nuget).
risk: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads a `globalPackagesFolder` outside the workspace.
